findings.title: Mini Shai-Hulud npm Worm Wave 2 — 416 Versions / 170+ Packages With Valid SLSA Provenance Attestations Cryptographic-Trust Breakdown
findings.affected_technology: npm + PyPI ecosystem (TanStack, Mistral AI, UiPath, Guardrails AI, OpenSearch, BetterStack + 165 others); GitHub Actions cache + OIDC token theft + orphaned-commit optional-dependency propagation
findings.summary: Second Shai-Hulud wave reached 416 malicious package artifacts; 84 of the TanStack versions shipped with valid SLSA provenance attestations from npm's signing infrastructure, breaking cryptographic-attestation defenses defenders had been told were authoritative.
findings.first_seen_at: bleepingcomputer.com — Shai Hulud attack ships signed malicious TanStack, Mistral npm packages

findings.title: Fortinet FortiSandbox CVE-2026-26083 + FortiAuthenticator CVE-2026-44277 — Critical Unauthenticated RCEs On Perimeter Security Appliances
findings.affected_technology: FortiSandbox 4.4 / 5.0 + Cloud + PaaS; FortiAuthenticator 6.5.x / 6.6.x / 8.0.x (Cloud IDaaS unaffected)
findings.summary: Fortinet shipped two critical unauthenticated-RCE advisories on 2026-05-12: missing authorization in FortiSandbox web UI + API command injection, and improper access control in FortiAuthenticator (the MFA / SAML IdP product).
findings.first_seen_at: bleepingcomputer.com — Fortinet warns of critical RCE flaws in FortiSandbox and FortiAuthenticator

findings.title: Apache Tomcat 7-CVE Batch — Digest Authenticator Bypass, AJP Secret Timing Attack, Security Constraint Bypass, WebDAV / HTTP2 / WebSocket Protocol Issues
findings.summary: Mark Thomas disclosed seven Tomcat CVEs on 2026-05-12 covering digest-authenticator bypass, LockOutRealm case-sensitivity, AJP secret timing attack (Ghostcat-class on success), security constraint bypass, plus WebDAV/HTTP-2/WebSocket protocol issues.
findings.first_seen_at: openwall.com/lists/oss-security 2026/05/12 — Mark Thomas Tomcat CVE thread

findings.title: Exim CVE-2026-45185 'Dead.Letter' — BDAT-Over-GnuTLS Use-After-Free → Heap Corruption / RCE Primitive On Internet-Facing MTAs
findings.affected_technology: Exim 4.97 → 4.99.2 compiled with USE_GNUTLS=yes (Debian default; OpenSSL builds unaffected); patched 4.99.3
findings.summary: Exim use-after-free in BDAT body parsing during TLS close_notify with GnuTLS builds writes one attacker-controlled byte into freed heap memory, a viable RCE primitive class; XBOW characterizes as one of the highest-caliber bugs in Exim's history.
findings.first_seen_at: thehackernews.com — New Exim BDAT Vulnerability Exposes GnuTLS Builds to Code Execution

findings.title: OpenClaude CVE-2026-42074 Sandbox Bypass Via Model-Controlled dangerouslyDisableSandbox Flag — Sixth AI-Agent Attack Surface In 14 Days
findings.summary: OpenClaude exposes a dangerouslyDisableSandbox boolean parameter to the LLM in its BashTool schema with permissive default, so any prompt-injection that emits the flag yields sandbox-free command execution as the OpenClaude process owner.

findings.title: esm.sh CVE-2026-44593 + CVE-2026-44594 — Legacy Route Path Traversal → Arbitrary File Write → RCE On Widely-Used Public JS Module CDN
findings.affected_technology: esm.sh (Go-based public + self-hostable npm-as-ESM CDN) prior to commit 1960055e1d53 (2026-05-08)
findings.summary: esm.sh legacy router concatenates percent-encoded path-traversal sequences into the filesystem path, allowing arbitrary on-disk file writes and overwriting of system binaries — RCE on a CDN that resolves import URLs for an entire org.

findings.title: SAP S/4HANA CVE-2026-34260 SQL Injection + Commerce Cloud CVE-2026-34263 Missing-Auth → Code Execution
findings.affected_technology: SAP Commerce Cloud (Spring Security misconfiguration → unauth RCE); SAP S/4HANA (SQL injection via direct user-input concatenation)
findings.summary: SAP May 2026 Patch Day shipped two Critical enterprise-RCE-class advisories: a missing-auth code execution in Commerce Cloud and an SQL injection in S/4HANA reachable with basic privileges.
findings.first_seen_at: securityweek.com — SAP Patches Critical S/4HANA, Commerce Vulnerabilities

findings.title: Microsoft May 2026 Patch Tuesday — 120 CVEs / 17 Critical, First Zero-Day-Free Patch Tuesday In ~2 Years
findings.affected_technology: Windows (DNS Client, Native WiFi, Netlogon, Hyper-V, Graphics, GDI), Microsoft Office + Word, SharePoint, Dynamics 365, M365 Copilot, Microsoft SSO Plugin for Jira/Confluence
findings.summary: Microsoft addressed 120 CVEs with 17 Critical-class RCEs across Windows networking stacks, Office document handling, Dynamics 365, and the SSO Plugin for Jira/Confluence — first Patch Tuesday in ~2 years with zero in-the-wild zero-days.
findings.first_seen_at: bleepingcomputer.com — Microsoft May 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 120 flaws, no zero-days

findings.title: Adobe Connect CVE-2026-34660 — Authorization Vulnerability Enabling Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.3)
findings.affected_technology: Adobe Connect 2025.9.15 and earlier; 2025.8.157 and earlier
findings.summary: Adobe Connect authorization flaw allows arbitrary code execution via script injection in web pages; widely deployed in regulated-industry training stacks; one of 52 Adobe CVEs disclosed 2026-05-12 across 10 products.
findings.first_seen_at: securityweek.com — Adobe Patches 52 Vulnerabilities in 10 Products

findings.title: protobuf.js 6-CVE Batch — Code Injection / OS Command Injection / Prototype Pollution / DoS
findings.summary: Six protobuf.js CVEs cover code injection via bytes-field defaults in toObject generation, OS command injection in CLI static output, code-generation-gadget after prototype pollution, and DoS variants — high-impact for any service that ingests user-supplied .proto schemas.

findings.title: Cleanuparr CVE-2026-44183 — X-Forwarded-For Spoofing Yields Unauthenticated Administrator Access (CVSS 9.8)
findings.affected_technology: Cleanuparr < 2.9.10 (containerized media-stack cleanup utility commonly run alongside Sonarr/Radarr/Jellyfin)
findings.summary: Cleanuparr parses the leftmost X-Forwarded-For header value as the client IP, letting any attacker submit 127.0.0.1 and gain unauthenticated administrator access to the admin UI.

findings.title: RubyGems Mass Malicious Package Upload — Sign-Ups Temporarily Suspended
findings.summary: RubyGems suspended new account registration after hundreds of malicious packages were uploaded in a coordinated campaign primarily targeting Mend.io's research infrastructure, with some carrying broader exploits.
findings.first_seen_at: thehackernews.com — RubyGems Suspends New Signups After Hundreds of Malicious Packages Are Uploaded
